general.dl: Rolling — apply Sept/Oct; merit auto with admission
general.note: The value anchor of this list: automatic merit by GPA tier drops net cost near in-state levels, own MD school + Banner University Medical Center on campus for clinical/research hours. WUE caveat: Arizona is a LIMITED-PARTICIPATION WUE member — the award is competitive, capacity-capped and decided program-by-program, NOT a guaranteed rate every WUE-state applicant gets. Arizona publishes no WUE dollar figure; the policy is 150% of resident tuition, so the ~$18,252/yr figure is OUR OWN calculation (FY27 resident tuition $12,168 × 1.5), not an official published number. Treat the merit tiers, not WUE, as the reliable discount here.
general.medNote: Guaranteed-tier merit means no scholarship lottery. Franke Honors adds small classes at flagship scale.
